row.Title: Flashforge Flexible product page (archived 2025-10-08)
row.Source note: The Flashforge product page for Flexible as the Internet Archive captured it on 2025-10-08 (the live address now answers 404). The page titles the product "Flashforge PLA Flexible Filament" where the registered TDS says PBAT; it is taken as the same product (same name, shop address and SKU). Its windows differ from the TDS's (nozzle 190~240 vs 200~240 C, bed 25~60 vs room temperature~60 C, speed 20~200 vs 30~150 mm/s) and its drying schedule is 70 C for 5 hours where the TDS says 60 C for at least 5 hours: both statements stand.
row.Access note: Fetched 2026-10-04 by Claude Sonnet (reader round b41) as the raw capture (id_) of https://www.flashforge.com/products/flexible; the Internet Archive replays the page's own content encoding, and the decoded HTML is the document hashed. Staged by digest (ingest:witness --from); the page's maker does not serve it now.
